I told Dana in #north-team that the settled seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **100 seats**, and posted it as a reply on her message.

- **Why not 261:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. I couldn't find anything posted after that correction.
- **Why I could share it:** I checked that Dana is a member of both #north-team and #north-random, so she could already see the correction herself. A seat count is an account detail, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
